source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: During the resolution of attacks from any **[PRECISION]** weapons, the active player may, when Allocation Order (05.03) begins, choose an allocation group that contains a **CHARACTER** model visible to at least one attacking model, if the target unit has any. The chosen **CHARACTER** group then serves as the current allocation group until either those attacks are finished or that group is wiped out. When a **[PRECISION]** attack also carries **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]**, its mortal wounds go first to the **CHARACTER** group chosen for those attacks, provided that group is still alive.
